English

What is LIM · Less is More?

An anti-consumerism companion. Before you buy something you’re unsure about, you ask LIM; an AI weighs it across six dimensions (need, alternatives, emotion, long-term value, cost, environment), shows a 0–100 impulse index, and gives a gentle verdict — keep it, sleep on it, or skip it. Resisting becomes savings and a growing tree.

Getting started

  1. Create an account with your email.
  2. Answer four quick questions (income, household, budget) so advice fits you.
  3. Tap the ✦ button and describe what you want to buy.

FAQ

How many AI consultations do I get? Free accounts get 3 per day. LIM Plus is unlimited.

Is my financial information safe? Your profile is used only to personalize advice. Data is encrypted in transit, passwords are hashed, and we don’t use ad/tracking SDKs. See our Privacy Policy.

What is the 24-hour cooling-off list? Items you’re tempted by can be parked in your wishlist for a day. When the timer ends, decide again — many impulses pass overnight.

How do I change the app icon? Me → 更换 App 图标 / Change App Icon. Some icons are LIM Plus-only.

Managing your LIM Plus subscription

  • Prices: ¥18/month or ¥98/year (auto-renewing).
  • Manage or cancel: iPhone Settings → [your name] → Subscriptions. Cancelling keeps Plus until the end of the current period.
  • Restore purchases: open the Plus screen and tap “Restore”.
  • Payment is charged to your Apple ID; it renews unless cancelled ≥24h before the period ends.

Edit my profile / data Edit anytime in Me → basic info.

Delete my account and data Email support@lim.app from your account address with “Delete my account”; we remove your data within 30 days (excluding records we must keep by law).

Export my data Email support@lim.app to request a copy of your data.

Troubleshooting

  • Can’t sign in: check email/password; if you hit “too many attempts”, wait a minute and retry (a rate limit protects your account).
  • Data looks out of date / offline: LIM shows your last-synced data when the network is unavailable; it refreshes automatically when you’re back online.
  • Replay the intro: Me → 重新观看引导 / Replay onboarding.

简体中文

LIM · Less is More 是什么？

一个反消费主义的 AI 伙伴。当你想买、却不确定是否真需要时，问问 LIM——AI 从六个维度（需求、 替代、情感、长期价值、经济、环境）权衡，给出 0–100 的冲动指数与温柔的建议：可以拥有它 / 再想想 / 也许不必买。每一次忍住，都会变成省下的钱和一棵慢慢长大的树。

快速上手

  1. 用邮箱注册账户。
  2. 回答四个小问题（收入、家庭、预算），让建议更贴合你。
  3. 点 ✦ 按钮，描述你想买的东西。

常见问题

每天能咨询几次？ 免费账户每天 3 次，LIM Plus 无限次。

我的财务信息安全吗？ 画像仅用于个性化建议。数据传输全程加密、密码经哈希存储，且不使用广告/追踪 SDK。详见 隐私政策。

24 小时冷静期是什么？ 让你心动的东西可以先放进心愿单冷静一天，到期再决定一次——很多冲动，睡一觉就过去了。

如何更换 App 图标？ 我的 → 更换 App 图标。部分图标为 LIM Plus 专属。

管理 LIM Plus 订阅

  • 价格：¥18/月 或 ¥98/年（自动续订）。
  • 管理或取消：iPhone 设置 → [你的名字] → 订阅。取消后，Plus 会保留到当前周期结束。
  • 恢复购买：打开 Plus 页面，点“恢复购买”。
  • 费用通过你的 Apple ID 扣款；若未在周期结束前至少 24 小时取消，将自动续订。

编辑画像 / 数据 随时在我的 → 基本情况中修改。

删除账户与数据 用注册邮箱发邮件至 support@lim.app，注明“删除我的账户”；我们将在 30 天内删除你的数据 （依法须保留的除外）。

导出数据 发邮件至 support@lim.app 申请获取你的数据副本。

故障排查

  • 无法登录：检查邮箱/密码；若提示“操作过于频繁”，请稍等一分钟重试（限流用于保护账户）。
  • 数据像是旧的/离线：网络不可用时 LIM 会显示上次同步的数据，恢复联网后自动刷新。
  • 重看引导：我的 → 重新观看引导。
